messages:
Maya: Hey team — after the 504 spike postmortem yesterday I sketched a small proposal to reduce manual follow-ups. TL;DR: auto-create postmortem + action items, link actions to dashboard, and add lightweight handoff snippets to incident bot. WDYT?

Aditya: +1 on automation. The manual step where we copy actions into tracker is the biggest pain.

Lena: curious what 'auto-create' means — webhook to Jira or GitHub issues?

Maya: thinking first-class action objects in our PM tool (could be Airtable or internal dashboard) that the bot populates, then optionally sync to JIRA. Example flow:
```
1) Incident resolves -> incident-bot creates draft postmortem (pre-filled template)
2) Oncall marks 'accept draft' -> postmortem published
3) Actions created as separate records; owners assigned via @mentions
4) Dashboard shows open actions by owner + due date + status
```

postmortem-bot: Created draft postmortem: /pm/1801234567-draft (private)

Samir: Nice. Can the bot populate remediation severity and customer impact from incident metadata?

Maya: yes — incident meta already has severity, affected customers list, and timeline; bot can fill fields with those. Also propose automated reminders: 7 days and 21 days if actions still open.

Aditya: We should also add a 'handoff note' that gets injected into the oncall calendar event when the shift changes. Right now handoffs are manual and we lose context.

Lena: For dashboards — prefer Grafana plugin or our internal console? Grafana makes sense for metrics but actions metadata better in web app.

Maya: Proposal: build minimal action-dashboard as part of Redwood Console (product), but add Grafana panel for action-related metrics (MTTA, MTTD for the incident). Team owning Console: @Aditya take lead? 

Aditya: I can take lead on the dashboard side. Need specs for data model.

Maya: Data model sketch:
- action_id
- incident_ts
- title
- description
- owner (Slack handle)
- due_date
- status (open/in-progress/blocked/closed)
- severity
- customer_impact_notes

Samir: Add 'linked_pr' and 'linked_jira' fields. Also 'blocked_by' list.

postmortem-bot: Created action items: A-432, A-433. Assigned to Samir and Lena.

Lena: Quick UX ask: in the draft postmortem please include one-click 'assign to me' and 'claim' buttons.

Maya: Agreed. Also add 'auto-assign to primary oncall if unclaimed in 24h'.

Aditya: Timeline? I'd like a 2-week spike + prototype in staging. If postmortem-bot changes are small we can ship earlier.

Maya: Plan: 
- Week 1: spec + wireframes (Maya + Aditya) 
- Week 2: bot changes + dashboard prototype (Samir + Aditya)
- Week 3: staging test + pilot (oncall rotation)

Samir: I'll prep a migration script to backfill actions from last 90 days for testing.

ops-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation tomorrow 09:00 UTC — Maya handing off to Lena. Please ensure any open actions are tagged.

Lena: noted. I'll review the draft tonight.

Maya: OK — owners: Maya spec/wireframes, Aditya dashboard + infra, Samir bot + backfill. I'll schedule a 30m sync for Mon 11:00am UTC. @Aditya @Samir can you make it?

Aditya: yes

Samir: yes

Maya: thanks. putting tickets in backlog: PM-742 (spec), PM-743 (bot), PM-744 (dashboard). I'll link here once created. :thumbsup:

postmortem-bot: Reminder: unresolved actions older than 7 days for incident 1801234567: A-432

Lena: good signal. One last ask — include 'customer notification required' boolean so we can filter for action items that require comms.

Maya: noted and added to data model.

Maya: closing thread for now; follow-up sync Mon 11:00 UTC. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
